record.title: Choose a bounded calibration environment hypothesis from static evidence
record.intent: Admit selective dynamic validation only for unresolved behavior that matters to stock initialization.
requirements: Evaluate the verified graph and select a complete bounded region with explicit predictions divergence stops and synthetic-state limitations; do not rediscover deterministic stores individually.
Prefer reconstruction of witnessed file or Android dependencies when justified and treat hardware-returned state DMA interrupts and thread effects as separate modeled hypotheses.
Draft plan inspect admit and commit any successor before execution; reconcile material architecture changes and preserve stock inputs and the no-physical-instrument boundary.
acceptance: Commit and push the decision and any admitted successor before execution.
